title: An Exact Mass Threshold for Global Existence and Blow-up in Semilinear Anti-de Sitter Equations
summary: We study the influence of the mass parameter on global existence and finite-time blow-up for the semilinear anti-de Sitter Klein--Gordon equation \[ φ_{tt}-e^{2t}Δφ+nφ_t+m^2φ=|φ|^p \qquad\text{in }[0,\infty)\times\R^d. \] After removing the damping term, we establish $L^2$ energy estimates for the resulting Klein--Gordon equation with constant coefficient in the potential.
